units.source_text: “那样不好，这样就行了，我习惯了。”

en.t: That would not be good. This is fine; I am used to it.

units.source_text: 她说着端端正正地坐起来，挺着胸脯，只觉得憋得慌。

en.t: As she said this, she sat up properly and thrust out her chest, but only felt unbearably short of breath.

units.source_text: 推开窗扇，想吐又吐不出来。

en.t: She pushed the window open, wanting to vomit, but nothing would come out.

units.source_text: 她本想扭动身子翻滚几下，可是咬紧牙关强忍住了。

en.t: She wanted to twist her body and roll about, but she clenched her teeth and forced herself to endure it.
This went on for quite some time.

units.source_text: 有时又振作起精神，连连嚷着要回去。

en.t: At times she would rally herself again and keep insisting that she had to go back.

units.source_text: 不知不觉间已过深夜两点。

en.t: Before they knew it, it was already past two in the morning.
